{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment turns negative, forecast prices need more downward correction than model suggests to account for lagging market reaction",
    "Model forecasts overshoot true outcomes in the short term due to mean-reversion bias, especially when prices have been trending",
    "Negative sentiment periods require greater forecast deviation from model than positive sentiment does",
    "When prices are in a downtrend, model forecasts are too high and need immediate downward adjustment",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to neutral requires more forecast adjustment than the model indicates",
    "When historical prices show high volatility, reduce confidence in model forecasts and increase deviation from them",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes increases with horizon, requiring more gradual convergence"
] }
